payload.override_rationale: smith epic verdict cannot see this epic. The plan declares qualified task ids (envkit-config-loader/task-N) while every execution was recorded under a bare id (task-N), so the verdict folds one task instead of six and reports nonTerminalTaskCount 1 with openFindings []. Known defect D-28, predicted before the run and confirmed by it. Closed by hand because fixing the id convention is a schema-boundary change plus a migration for the existing log, which is Phase 9 work rather than a patch applied mid-run.

integration_checks.lint_note: Exit 1 from nested-root biome config discovery across the six task worktrees under the project root, not from any source file. Identical command exits 0 with wt/ moved aside. Finding D-42.

carry_forward_defects.summary: Bare CR is not treated as a line separator, so a CR-delimited assignment is silently swallowed into the preceding value and the swallowed key falls back to its schema default with ok:true and zero issues. Reproduced independently. Unfixed: raised while gating task-4, whose claims forbid it to touch parse.ts, and intakeAndDecide applies no claims-scoping, so the finding has no task that may legally remedy it.

Task worktrees are created inside the project root, so the assembled branch cannot run a root-walking lint even though every per-task lint gate passed. Local-only: wt/ is untracked, so CI is unaffected.

payload.note: This event exists because the epic's own close verb could not emit one: runEpicVerdict returns on mechanical blockers before its only appendEvent, by design (epic.ts:263, 'zero events (read-only projection)'). Without this record the terminal decision that stopped the epic would be absent from the log, the projector and the UI.
